propositions: The lru_cache on _rendered() is process-local, causing each xdist worker to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns each), duplicating work across workers when run with -n 3 --dist worksteal
Fixed-point tests recompute pass-1 render via render_markdown_to_wiki() for each body, duplicating the pass-1 values already computed and cached by _rendered()

Replace process-local lru_cache with a session-scoped disk artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON files, wiki_render module source, and pandoc executable metadata, shared across xdist workers via tmp_path_factory

Artifact is sharded per stratum with inter-process lock via os.mkdir for mutual exclusion and os.replace for atomic publication, with 150s loser fallback deadline to degrade gracefully under timeout rather than deadlock
